name: PORMAKE hypothetical MOFs for MOFTransformer
description: PORMAKE-generated, UFF-optimized hypothetical MOF coordinates released for MOFTransformer pretraining.
count_scope: Provider count for primitive_cif.tar.gz in Figshare 21810147 v2

sources.title: 1 million hypothetical MOFs — Figshare v2 metadata
sources.evidence: Provider specifies exactly 1,118,074 CIF structures generated by PORMAKE, UFF optimization, and MOFTransformer pretraining; release lists a 9,486,581,409-byte primitive_cif.tar.gz and dataset-level CC BY 4.0.

caveats: Hypothetical geometries are not experimentally synthesized or DFT-validated materials.
Count is independently verified against dataset metadata, not a local enumeration of the 9.49 GB CIF archive.
MOFTransformer embeddings of CoRE/QMOF are derivative representations of existing parent datasets; this record instead covers its released hypothetical pretraining structures.

name: MOFX-DB computational adsorption database
description: Combined computed adsorption isotherms, textural properties and CIFs for MOFs and zeolites, with simulation metadata.
count_scope: Sum of live databases.json counts; records across source databases, not globally deduplicated materials
license: Not verified: open API and bulk downloads; no dataset-wide reuse license confirmed

sources.title: MOFX-DB source-database counts API
sources.evidence: Live API returns CoREMOF 2014 4,764; CoREMOF 2019 12,020; hMOF 137,953; IZA 216; PCOD-syn 70; Tobacco 13,511; CSD 0.

sources.title: MOFX-DB bulk downloads
sources.evidence: Provider states each download includes CIFs and isotherms; gas-specific archives contain subsets of the isotherms. Live tobmof-4188 response independently returned CIF fractional coordinates and isotherm metadata.

sources.title: MOFX-DB primary publication record
sources.evidence: Primary article describes over 3 million simulated adsorption data points, seven gas species and over 160,000 MOFs/zeolites, with reproducibility metadata.

caveats: Aggregates and overlaps existing hMOF, CoRE MOF, IZA and PCOD catalog records and the ToBaCCo entry; do not add their structure totals.
Isotherm data points, isotherm curves and structure records are different units.
Force-field simulation outputs are not experimental adsorption measurements.
Parent data rights may differ; GitHub archive repository has no detected license and the footer image credit is not a data license.

count_derivation.method: Sum nonzero mofs fields from live databases.json; CSD has zero and is omitted

name: ToBaCCo hypothetical MOF structure database
description: Topologically constructed hypothetical MOFs released with textural and computed gas-adsorption data through MOFX-DB.
count_scope: Live MOFX-DB Tobacco subset, excluding the originally reported null structure
license: Not verified: public MOFX-DB structure downloads; reuse license not confirmed

sources.title: MOFX-DB Tobacco subset count
sources.evidence: Live API lists Tobacco with 13,511 MOFs.

sources.title: MOFX-DB ToBaCCo structure and property sample
sources.evidence: Returned parent database metadata, periodic CIF atomic fractional coordinates, and associated adsorption information for tobmof-4188.

sources.title: MOFX-DB author manuscript
sources.evidence: Explains that 13,512 ToBaCCo structures were originally reported including one null structure with no atoms; MOFX-DB excludes it and distributes 13,511 valid structures.

caveats: This is a subset of MOFX-DB; both records must not be summed.
Generated structures have not all been synthesized; QMOF also adopts selected ToBaCCo parents.
Count differs from the original 13,512 because one null structure is excluded.

name: NIST/ARPA-E adsorption isotherm database (NIST-ISODB)
description: Literature-traceable single- and multicomponent adsorption measurements for solid adsorbents, including MOFs and zeolites.
count_scope: Historical provider count as of 2023-12-01; not the current live total or number of crystals
license: Not verified: NIST metadata links generic open-data license, but database homepage requests contacting technical staff about data licensing/reproduction

sources.title: NIST Data Resources for Adsorption
sources.evidence: Provider gives 37,703 isotherms, 8,265 adsorbents, 449 adsorbates and 4,367 articles as of December 1, 2023. Isotherms derive from interlaboratory studies, contributed data or tabulation/digitization of published articles; API formats include JSON/XML/CSV.

sources.title: NIST dataset metadata
sources.evidence: Dataset DOI, public access and API distribution are explicitly listed, with a link to generic NIST open-license terms.

sources.title: NIST-ISODB homepage
sources.evidence: Live homepage content states data are measured adsorption properties and asks users to consult technical contacts for licensing or reproduction of the data contents. API documentation lists isotherm and material endpoints.

caveats: Isotherms are measurements/curves, not independent crystal structures.
Includes noncrystalline sorbents; the 37,703 total is not a porous-crystal-only count.
Registry may link external crystallographic records; periodic coordinates are not guaranteed in each isotherm.
Direct API JSON attempts returned HTTP 403 during this check; browser homepage and API documentation were retrievable.
Historical 2023 count is explicitly retained because a new live inventory could not be fetched.

name: PhononMOFdb
description: MACE-MP-MOF0-derived phonon, vibrational thermodynamic and mechanical properties linked to QMOF identifiers.
count_scope: Unique QMOF-ID YAML files in Thermal.zip, excluding __MACOSX resource-fork files and directory entries

sources.title: PhononMOFdb Figshare release metadata
sources.evidence: Describes approximately 12,000 QMOF-ID-labelled MOFs; lists Thermal.zip, DOS_data.zip, INS_spectra.zip, Band_data.zip, DFT_ZIF-8.zip and script.py under CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: PhononMOFdb Thermal.zip payload
sources.evidence: Independently enumerated 11,900 non-resource-fork .yml files with 11,900 unique QMOF IDs. Sample YAML contains temperature, heat_capacity, free_energy, entropy and energy values.

sources.title: Data-driven Design of MOFs with Tunable Negative Thermal Expansion
sources.evidence: Methods specify applying MACE-MP-MOF0 v2 to QMOF structures, Phonopy thermal properties, equation-of-state bulk moduli and simulated INS; most corpus properties are model-computed.

caveats: Parent geometries overlap QMOF; this is a new property layer, not 11,900 new experimentally established compounds.
11,900 is the exact inspected thermal archive scope; other archives can have different membership and were not exhaustively enumerated.
Main corpus predictions from an MLIP are distinct from the limited DFT and experimental validation data.

name: MACE-MP-MOF0 DFT training configurations
description: Periodic MOF configurations with DFT energies, forces and stress for fine-tuning MACE-MP-MOF0.
count_scope: Current downloadable v2 archive: 3,611 train, 331 validation and 369 test extXYZ frames
license: CC BY 4.0 (explicit mace-mof-0 folder data license)

sources.title: MACE-MP-MOF0 dataset README
sources.evidence: States v2 contains the DFT dataset split into train/test/validation; separately provides 127 curated input CIFs, 70 out-of-sample QMOF MOFs and phonon/property results.

sources.title: MACE-MP-MOF0 data license
sources.evidence: Explicitly licenses all data in this repository under CC BY 4.0, requiring citation of the associated publication.

sources.title: MACE-MP-MOF0 v2 training payload
sources.evidence: Parsed extXYZ frame boundaries: train.xyz 3,611; valid.xyz 331; test.xyz 369. Comment fields include Lattice, species/pos, dft_forces, dft_energy and dft_stress.

caveats: Current released archive count 4,311 differs from the final article claim of 4,764 DFT data points; catalog count deliberately scopes the inspected payload.
Configurations are correlated samples from a curated 127-MOF parent set, including QMOF-derived frameworks; not 4,311 distinct compounds.
The broader GitHub folder includes models and derived properties; they are not counted as additional DFT frames.

additional_counts.scope: Provider curated input-CIF set; not configuration-frame count

count_derivation.method: Parse atom-count-prefixed complete extXYZ frames in the three v2 archive splits

name: Nanoporous-material heat-capacity DFT and prediction dataset
description: DFT heat capacities and local atomic contributions for MOFs, COFs and zeolites, with larger model-predicted heat-capacity tables.
count_scope: Rows excluding header in DFT/DFT_cp_allstructures.csv inside database_heat_capacity.zip

sources.title: Nanoporous heat-capacity release metadata
sources.evidence: Release files include DFT_calculations.zip, ML.zip and database_heat_capacity.zip; dataset rights are explicitly CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Provider file descriptions
sources.evidence: States DFT_calculations.zip contains heat capacity, crystal structure and phonon outputs for MOFs/COFs/zeolites; larger tables cover 250–400 K in parent databases.

sources.title: Heat-capacity table payload inspection
sources.evidence: DFT_cp_allstructures.csv has 232 data rows; DFT_site_projected_cp.csv 17,619 rows. Model tables have QMOF 20,373, IZA 229, CURATEDMOFs 3,257, CURATEDCOFs 656 and CoREMOFs_ASR 6,905 rows.

caveats: Parent structures overlap CoRE, QMOF, CURATED and IZA; this adds property labels rather than new chemical identities.
31,420 model table rows are not DFT measurements and can overlap across parent databases.
232 DFT rows are the released table scope; paper describes approximately 230 selected structures.
Experimental electronic-lab-notebook data are a linked companion on Zenodo, not included in the DFT count.

additional_counts.scope: Sum of five ML table row counts; not deduplicated across parent collections
Atomic-site contributions, distinct from parent structures

name: SymGNN aluminum-substituted zeolite adsorption dataset
description: Zeolite topology geometries, Si/Al substitution arrays and simulated heat-of-adsorption labels released with the SymGNN benchmark.
count_scope: Sum of first dimensions of Data_numpy/*/atoms.npy and matching hoa.npy arrays in archived release

sources.title: SymGNN archived release metadata
sources.evidence: Open archive v0.0.1 with 11,325,197-byte SymGNN zip; metadata licenses it CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: SymGNN archived payload inspection
sources.evidence: 227 Data_numpy topology folders contain atoms.npy, hoa.npy, hoa_err.npy, pos.npy, pos_o.npy, lens.npy and angs.npy; total occupancy/hoa rows is 57,084. Code loads these geometry and label arrays.

sources.title: Symmetry-informed graph neural networks for CO2 adsorption in substituted zeolites
sources.evidence: Primary article links structures, adsorption properties and models to the archived release and describes simulated versus experimental transfer limitations.

caveats: 57,084 rows are substitution/property cases on 227 shared topology geometries, not 57,084 distinct experimentally solved framework types.
The archived Data_numpy payload directly verifies heat-of-adsorption labels; this record does not claim that every full isotherm in the article is included.
Direct article fetch encountered HTTP 403 after search-index retrieval; release payload and Zenodo rights were independently obtained.
Si/Al distributions are generated structural variants; framework coordinates are shared per topology.

additional_counts.scope: Archived Data_numpy directories with atoms.npy arrays

name: ZeoDiff zeolite diffusion structure-property dataset
description: Zeolite geometry descriptors and diffusion targets packaged with CIF inputs and a diffusion-prediction application.
count_scope: Unique first-column zeolite names in Dataset/zeolite_diffusion_dataset.xlsx; excludes header and demonstration predictions

sources.title: ZeoDiff archived release metadata
sources.evidence: Open v1.0 software/data release, CC BY 4.0, with a 14,263,821-byte repository archive.

sources.title: ZeoDiff payload inspection
sources.evidence: Dataset spreadsheet has 4,194 data rows and 4,194 distinct zeolite names; fields include PLD, PLD/LCD, Vacc, FDSi, ASA, Tort, cross-section statistics and Ds. Dataset/CIF/Zeolites.rar packages coordinates separately.

sources.title: Harnessing confinement effect and interpretable ML to predict alkane diffusion
sources.evidence: Primary paper abstract describes high-throughput molecular simulations of zeolite frameworks and methane diffusion with transfer to other small molecules. It reports a screening scale of approximately 100,000 frameworks, distinct from the released spreadsheet scope.

caveats: 4,194 is the inspected released descriptor spreadsheet scope, not the approximately 100,000 frameworks screened in the article.
Spreadsheet target Ds scaling and simulation conditions require consulting the article and inputs before quantitative reuse.
The separate nested RAR CIF collection was identified but not decompressed here; exact coordinate coverage for every row was not independently verified.
Original parent framework topology collections overlap IZA and PCOD; new diffusion labels do not constitute new framework topologies.
